Name: Sit N' Relax Rest Your Butt
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
(It seems I'm not the only one with this Idea, so I took extra time to make this more functional)
Sit N' Relax is a simple mod that detects when you are sitting..
Afterwards, every 6 seconds the mod will check your stamina.  If you're not at max Stamina, you will get 4 Stamina back until you're at max.  If you are at max, the mod then [b]Checks your Health.[/b]  If you're not at max health, you will receive 4 HP every 6 seconds until you are at max.
Complete with a message to let you know you're relaxing in your seat for immersive purposes. <3

[b]1.5.4
[/b]- Added [b]Notification Toggle[/b] You may now disable the screen notifications by pressing [b]CTRL + N[/b] it will default to true unless you change it to false in the config.json
[b]1.5.0
- [/b]Added [b]Extended Rest State!  [/b]After a certain amount of time, the farmer rests even more and slowly gains a bonus multiplier!  You can gain up to 5x the stamina/heath while sitting.  Extended Rest is configurable in the config.json
[b]1.4.0
- [/b]Added multiple messages that are chosen randomly... change them in the new config.json
[b]- [/b]Added sit damage penalty..  If you sit somewhere and take damage you will receive 1.5x the damage!
[b]1.3.0
[/b]-[b] [/b]Splitscreen works now!
[b]- [/b]Added in a check to see if you're in a menu.  You can no longer regenerate health by stopping time in a menu.
[b]1.1.0
- [/b]Customize the regeneration rate (how many seconds per regen tick)
[b]- [/b]Customize the amount of stamina given per tick.
[b]- [/b]Customize the amount of health given per tick.
[b]- [/b]Customize the message when sitting(Note:  You only adjust the end.. the name will always be at the front. So make sentences like this: [i]"takes a well deserved seat."[/i]}

This mod requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ to run.  Be sure to have the latest version!!

Place this mod in the [b]Mods[/b] folder and start your game.  It will be active as soon as you start.  It should work locally so multiplayer might not be a problem (need testers)
